Release asset digests match the published GitHub SHA-256 values. Both upstream
license files are retained. No parser code is edited locally. The owning Node
runtime uses this library for WHATWG parsing, normalization, IDNA and query
encoding. The neighboring bridge owns native lifetime and error translation;
neither the Tsonic host nor target planner recognizes URL spellings.
